name: Vendoroo AI

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; frame-src 'self' https://*.vendoroo.ai; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.vendoroo.ai https://*.amazonaws.com https://*.s3.amazonaws.com; connect-src 'self' https://storage.vapi.ai https://*.posthog.com https://*.vendoroo.ai https://*.amazonaws.com https://*.s3.amazonaws.com; media-src 'self' blob: https://storage.vapi.ai https://*.vendoroo.ai https://*.amazonaws.com https://*.twilio.com https://*.s3.amazonaws.com;

_comment_web_accessible_resources: `constants.js` below is load-bearing beyond the extension itself: the PMRoo web app HEAD-requests it to detect that the extension is installed (see packages/data/src/utils/chrome-extension-installed.ts, VUE-3771). Removing it, or setting use_dynamic_url to true, breaks that detection and makes the install promo nag users who already have the extension.
